description: Two verbatim-origin official 5.0.0 docstring examples migrated to unmodified 9.0.0 source, plus one healthy control. These are documented version migrations, not current upstream bugs.

evaluation.external_checks_authorship: AI-assisted and frozen before model evaluation; independent of model-added assertions
evaluation.reference_candidates: proposals.json; engineering replay only, withheld from model input

limitations: Examples are intentionally evaluated against a newer library version; no claim that 5.0.0 documentation was broken on 5.0.0.
Two migration failures and one healthy control cannot establish project-wide reliability or model generalization.
Public upstream examples may be present in model pretraining; held out refers to this local evaluation and prompt-development history only.
Doctest conversion adds an import and print wrappers; original statements, values and expected outputs are separately retained.
External behavior checks share an interpreter with candidate code and are not a complete adversarial security boundary.

cases.title: Sorted merge: removed collate
cases.behavior: Merge sorted inputs, preserve duplicates, honor numeric key and reverse ordering.

cases.title: Grouped items: changed argument order
cases.behavior: Fixed-size groups in source order, preserve the last item, pad the final group with x.

cases.title: Healthy incomplete final chunk
cases.behavior: Groups into lists; the last chunk remains shorter and is not padded.
